notes: §1985:VI.3.2.1.1 prints the division as the header, the PROGRAM-ID paragraph and five optional comment-entry paragraphs, each a paragraph header with its period followed by comment-entries, in a fixed order; §1985:III defines a paragraph header as 'A reserved word, followed by the separator period'. Implemented at 85: identificationDivision and identificationBody require PROGRAM-ID first, VersionConformancePass.VisitIdentificationDivision refuses a missing header (COBOL0900), the fixed-form logical conversion (CommentEntryOf, CommentEntryHeader) opens the paragraph at an Area-A word and discards the entry, and ClosedFormatPass refuses a repeated or misplaced paragraph. The header's own period is asked of the source (kb/Work PB5168): CommentEntryHeader reports COBOL7166 at the word when no separator period follows it in fixed form (a period after spaces, or a header alone on its line, is a header; a period glued to the entry's first word is not), and writes the paragraph whole so the parse recovers; free form keeps docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-CE1's optional period.
